text:
The service was excellent, it is very clean, modern & comfortable!
My husband and I, have been coming to AoNang Krabi for 18 years and have visited various dentists in the region for treatment. Dental Box Clinic is fairly new to AoNang, approximately 12 months old, it wasn’t here during our previous visit. So we decided to give this new dentist a try last night.
We both had our teeth cleaned and scaled and are both very satisfied. The prices are reasonable and the clinic is in a good location, easy to travel to while staying in AoNang.
At times it was a little hard to hear or understand what the dentist is saying to you, as he is wearing a mask and also a shield. So just be a little patient and ask him politely to repeat himself, or let him know that you can’t hear him.
I was very impressed with their communications, as I contacted them by WhatsApp to make enquires and a booking, they responded promptly!

Keep up the good service and well done to the staff at this practice!
🙏👍
